fee_notes: Single-unit fee is $50,000. Area Development Agreement replaces with Development Fee: $100,000 for 2 shops; $35,000/shop for 3-5 shops ($105,000-$175,000); $30,000/shop for 6-9 shops; $25,000/shop for 10+ shops. 20% discount for veterans/active-duty military or minority-owned businesses (cannot be combined). In fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025, Initial Franchise Fees received ranged from $0 to $45,000.
raw_excerpt: when you sign a Franchise Agreement to develop a single Shop, you must pay us an initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $50,000.
